nets.source_note: Native FMTD-0 rail crosses both AR and AT output branches without diamonds.
AT.B03 branches to AV.D06 and AR.D06 below the FMTD-0 rail; both crossings are unjoined.
Native AA.D10 and AB.KD06 physically join on a two-diamond vertical rail.
Printed diamond after AF.B13 fans to AG.D09 and a separate upper rail that enters AK.B13.
Only AH B12 and D08 are connected by this short printed jumper; no external lead is visible.
AH output alone feeds the AL upper input. AG.B03 crosses this rail without a diamond.
FMTU-0 passes AJ.D10, AK.B13, and AK.D12 on plain crossings, then enters AK.D13.
AG.B03 crosses AH output and the FMTU-0 horizontal without diamonds; it alone enters AJ.D10.
The native bit-36-zero vertical joins AJ output at a diamond below AK; it reaches AK.D12 and AL middle input. The AL branch crosses AK output without a diamond.

review_notes.evidence: Original TIFF SHA256 59a0283375c1f834d3548dfc24138bb997b2172f8c4483e25176fbdc8ee463c1; source filename retains AND, while printed title has an open diamond ◇. Original file was not renamed.
26 printed component card portions match all 26 entries in the A1 socket listing. The large 6L OR/DOT symbol is printed without unit, card, or location fields and is retained as uncarded.

All 52 input terminals and output rails were traced through the native full scan and enlarged crops. The FMTD-0 rail crosses AR/AT branches without diamonds; AT.B03 feeds AV.D06 and AR.D06 independently of FMTD-0. AU.B04, AV.B04 and AP.B02 print terminal asterisks. AH B12/D08 form only a short local jumper with no printed external lead. AF.B13 branches at a printed diamond to AG.D09 and AK.B13; AG.B03 alone enters AJ.D10 across the plain FMTU-0 crossing. FMTU-0 enters AJ.B08 and AK.D13. The BIT36 IS0 rail joins AJ output at the lower printed diamond and enters AK.D12 and the AL middle input. AH alone feeds the AL upper input; AK feeds the AL lower input.
Worn XM002 +FMTU-0 reference confirmed against XM035 BD4, which prints +FMTU-0 and the XM002 continuation.
Six footer pin cross-reference strings read from footer-left-source-exact.png and footer-left-enlarged.png and independently confirmed by the root reviewer.
Native heading appears PoNo. The shared printer grid uses the established P.N. convention; literal source reading is retained here.

Root independently inspected the native overview, all enlarged sectors and card fields, focused crossings and upstream rail routes, margins, footer and complete final preview. Corrected AR.D06 to AT branch separate from FMTD-0; restored terminal stars; AF.B13 diamond fans to AG.D09/AK.B13; AG.B03 crosses AH output and FMTU-0 plainly to AJ.D10; FMTU-0 feeds AJ.B08/AK.D13; bit36-zero joins AJ output at lower diamond to AK.D12/AL middle. AH output alone feeds AL upper. No unresolved source discrepancy remains.
